info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Discounts-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Discounts Retrieval API enables users to access and list available utility billing discounts efficiently. This service is geared towards utility providers and customer service representatives who need to review discount offerings for various billing cycles. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer engagement by informing clients of applicable savings. Typical use cases include generating reports for internal reviews or providing real-time information to customers inquiring about their utility discounts.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current discount information applicable to billing. It provides the necessary data to understand what discounts are available or applied at the moment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve discount details for billing operations. It should provide necessary parameters to specify the discount information being requested.
